text:
Maria Gomez: Quick heads-up — build plan for SI sandbox that bundles cloud marketplace listing + partner HW images. Need gating for SI certs and a lightweight enablement track. Who can lead scope? :eyes:
Alex Chen: I can take product-side for the marketplace listing flow. timeline?
Sam Patel: I can own the HW partner piece (drivers, AMI/OVF packaging). Will need a test matrix from eng-runtime.
Maria Gomez: Goal: private sandbox access to SIs + one-click deploy of HW bundle by mid-May. Certification + 2-day hands-on workshop before GA.
Kelsey Rivers: On enablement content — propose a 4-module path: 1) infra & networking, 2) runtime & ops, 3) cost/perf tuning, 4) joint support runbook. Short quizzes after each.
Jordan Lee: For gating, recommend a badge (bronze/silver) based on a checklist + demo call. Bronze = install + basic inference smoke test; Silver = performance + failover + billing integration.
Maria Gomez: Love the badge idea. Sam — can you surface the hardware compatibility matrix by EOW? Alex — need marketplace packaging checklist from you.
Sam Patel: Yep, matrix dropping Friday. Also need allowed list of kernel/driver versions from eng-runtime. Pinged @eng-runtime.
Alex Chen: Draft marketplace checklist below — feedback welcome:
```
- product listing metadata (logo, description, SKUs)
- deploy scripts (Terraform / CloudFormation / kube manifests)
- billing hook + pricing tiers
- support contact + onboarding playbook link
- test plan artifacts (smoke, perf)
```
Kelsey Rivers: Add one more: 'eval prompt set + regression tests' so we can run quality checks against model variants.
Maria Gomez: Good call. Also legal needs a short partner data-flow doc for Private deployments — @Jordan can you coordinate?
Jordan Lee: I’ll draft a template and loop in legal. Will aim for Monday.
Maria Gomez: On the cert timeline: propose a pilot cohort of 3 SIs week of Apr 22, run 2-day workshop + capture feedback, then formalize exam. Thoughts?
Sam Patel: Pilot works. Can we include one HW partner and one cloud marketplace-only SI to cover both flows?
Alex Chen: Yes. I’ll slot marketplace onboarding for Apr 22. Need content owners for each module.
Kelsey Rivers: I can run module 3 & 4 (cost/perf + support runbook). Maria — can you lead module 1?
Maria Gomez: Yep. Also need to create a short checklist for the pilot sign-up form. Minimal fields: company, contact, infra type, HW SKU (if any), expected qps.
onboard-bot: Reminder: draft pilot invite template is due in 3 days. Use /templates/partner-invite-v1 as base.
Jordan Lee: Action items summary — Sam: hardware matrix (due Fri). Alex: full marketplace checklist w/ packaging examples (due Wed). Kelsey: workshop slides + quizzes (due Apr 15). Maria: pilot recruit list + module1 slide deck (due Apr 10). Jordan: legal template (due Mon).
Maria Gomez: Great — we’ll sync next Tue 9am PT. If anyone hits blockers, drop notes here. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Linking reference: https://docs.redwood.inference/internal/partner-onboard/ (private)
Sam Patel: Adding note — we should include a small infra budget estimate per SI for sandbox costs to set expectations.
Kelsey Rivers: Also recommend tracking pass/fail per quiz and a short post-workshop survey (NPS + 3 specific capability questions).
Maria Gomez: Agreed. Thanks team — moving to prep mode.
